# Store Platform - Official E-Commerce Catalog & Information

> Premium Quality Online Shopping. Browse curated collections with Cash on Delivery nationwide.

## Core Store Information
- **Platform:** Store Platform
- **Customer Care Hotline:** +880 1700-000000
- **Official Email:** support@store.com
- **Distribution Hub:** Dhaka, Bangladesh

## Shipping & Delivery Policy
- **Coverage:** All 64 districts of Bangladesh via reliable courier partners.
- **Inside Dhaka:** 70 BDT (Delivery within 24 to 48 hours).
- **Outside Dhaka:** 130 BDT (Delivery within 48 to 72 hours).
- **Payment Methods:**
  - Cash on Delivery (COD) available nationwide.
  - Mobile Financial Services (bKash, Nagad, Rocket).
  - Online Cards & Digital Payments.

## Return, Authenticity & Refund Policy
- **Authenticity Guarantee:** 100% genuine and verified products.
- **Return Period:** 7-day hassle-free return window for damaged, incorrect, or defective items upon delivery handoff.
- **Customer Verification:** Parcel verification upon receipt with courier partner.
